title: Finding
description: One structured piece of reviewer feedback (security / scalability / dry) about a run's implementation, plus the lifecycle fields that let the retrospective project mine it for recurring signal. Emitted by a reviewer as the reply to project_call, and separately reported to Retrospective (record-finding) and updated by Done Gate (update-finding) once judged.

id.description: Stable id for this finding, e.g. `${runId}:${reviewer}:${category}:${n}`. Lets Done Gate and Retrospective reference the same finding across calls.

runId.description: The pipeline run this finding belongs to. Threaded through every project_call hop for this issue.

reviewer.description: Which reviewer project emitted this finding.

category.description: Short, stable, machine-groupable tag — not a free-text summary. Examples: `sql-injection`, `missing-authz-check`, `secret-in-code`, `n-plus-one-query`, `unbounded-loop`, `missing-index`, `duplicated-validation`, `duplicated-helper`, `copy-pasted-branch`. Retrospective groups by (reviewer, category) to detect recurrence — invent new categories sparingly; reuse an existing one when the same class of issue recurs.

severity.description: blocker fails Done Gate outright. major/minor/nit are judgment calls for Done Gate.

detail.description: Evidence: what you looked at, why it's a problem, the concrete risk.

suggestedFix.description: Concrete, actionable — a diff sketch or the exact change, not "be more careful".

planGap.description: true: the plan (from Planner) never anticipated this class of issue — Planner's prompt is the fix target. false: the plan covered it (explicitly or via a stated best practice) but Implementer diverged — Implementer's prompt is the fix target. null: not yet judged (set by Done Gate when it resolves the finding).

accepted.description: Set by Done Gate. true: legitimate and fixed (or explicitly acknowledged and tracked). false: dismissed as not applicable / false positive / out of scope for this run. null: pending Done Gate's judgment.

resolution.description: One line: what changed, or why it was dismissed. Required once accepted is non-null.
